events.verdict: Salaun (CHA) reaches for the ball and the contact with Black's (ORL) head during his dunk attempt is marginal.
Carter Jr. (ORL) jumps vertically and makes legal contact with the ball while contesting Salaun's (CHA) driving shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) firms up in Salaun's (CHA) path and absorbs the contact.
Williams (CHA) reaches in and makes contact with Wagner's (ORL) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Harris (ORL) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Ball (CHA). The contact between the two players while the ball is loose is marginal.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: After the ball becomes loose, Ball (CHA) is the last player to touch it before it goes out of bounds.
Carter Jr. (ORL) brushes Ball's (CHA) arm as he completes the pass.
Salaun (CHA) extends his left hand into Wagner's (ORL) front, affecting his SQBR at the start of his drive.
Ball (CHA) extends his hands into Black (ORL), dislodging him from his defensive position.
Diabaté (CHA) commits a take foul on Wagner (ORL).
Banchero (ORL) legally contests Bridges' (CHA) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
